description: This file defines an Angular component named Icon, which extends DynamicComponent. It includes component metadata, styles, and a template that displays an icon based on a dynamically resolved name. It imports Angular core features, a DynamicComponent base class, and primitives from an external library.

classes.name: Icon
classes.description: An Angular component for rendering icons with dynamic names, extending DynamicComponent and utilizing computed property for name resolution.

methods.name: resolvedName
methods.description: A computed property that resolves the primitive value of the icon's name input.

methods.name: name
methods.description: A required input property representing the icon name, accepting primitives or null.
